title: Farm Golding
html:
Quest Giver: Townston Commander

Quest Type: Discover

Quest Description: Head to Ratsputin's Gulag and find the farms on the folowing levels:

  • Rasputin's Gulag 1
  • Rasputin's Gulag 1 Subdungeon
  • Rasputin's Gulag 2
  • Rasputin's Gulag 3
  • Rasputin's Gulag 3 Subdungeon
  • Rasputin's Gulag 4
  • Rasputin's Gulag 4 Subdungeon


Quest Reward: 9375 Gold

Return to: Yakov Smearnov in Rasputin's Holding Cell

Repeatable: Unknown
